title: 第857章 灵酒之争十六第856章 灵酒之争十五
lines: 石岑话音落下的那一刻，垂在身侧的双臂仍在微微发颤，嘴角那一缕血丝在苍白的面容上格外醒目。
他抬眼望向对面楚君珩的身影，嘴唇翕动了一下，最终没有再多说什么，只是朝那个方向微微颔首，随即转身退回席位。
十星灵酿阁的厅堂内，在他转身离开后数息，陷入一种短暂的死寂。
但紧接着，那种寂静便被如潮水般涌起的哗然声淹没，如同被掀起的滚烫浪潮，一层一层向四面八方铺开。
谁也未曾料到，这位十年前仅能与二档中游实力的莫无忌战成平手的苍梧州修士，如今已然蜕变到这般骇人的地步。
一人身兼势、天命、杀伐三种高品级本源法则。
且三者掌控度极高，再配上成套圆满的顶级功法《明月策》，招式层层递进、连绵不绝，攻防牵制样样无懈可击。
与十年前的他早已是云泥之别，完全判若两人。
“这楚君珩怎么会强到这种地步？”
有人忍不住开口，语气里带着还未散尽的惊愕。
“是啊，明明之前和莫无忌交手，还只能勉强缠斗至力竭平局。”
“寻常修士耗费十年苦修，能稳稳精进一个小境界便已是天资过人，这楚君珩却直接从第二档天骄一跃踏入一档顶尖行列，这般巨大的跨越，纵观所有州域，恐怕都寻不出几个。”
“不过方才的柳乘风应该也算一个，还有姜望。”
“只能说苍梧州这批人，一个比一个能藏。”
众人此刻都在重新评估苍梧州真正的底蕴分量。
毕竟姜望的横空出世虽然足够震撼，但在许多人看来，一个小州域能出一位真正的一档顶尖强者已是极限。
可没想到，接着又是精通空间法则神通的柳乘风，加上如今比他更加强大的楚君珩——
这已意味着苍梧州并非只靠姜望一人撑场面，而是实打实拥有至少三位足以位列酒会一档的顶尖修士。
“先前是谁在说苍梧州只是一时运气好才出一个强者？现在恐怕没人再说这话了吧？”
“苍梧州灵气稀薄、资源稀缺，能在这般贫瘠环境都成长起来，若是生在瀚古、大渊这类灵气充沛，机缘众多的超级大州，他们的成就恐怕还会更高。”
眼看大家都在为楚君珩的实力震惊。
苍梧州众人却是心知肚明，方才那场对决，楚君珩甚至都还未动用自身全部底牌——
比如王者意境。
不过他们也能感受到，楚君珩各方面的能力相比问道会时，同样进步极大。
柳乘风先前虽凭空间本源神通接连击败两名强手，可第三场便遗憾落败。
反观楚君珩，根基浑厚扎实，比起柳乘风更加稳重，这在后面几场比试中，也能体现。
就见一道身着金线镶边衣袍、气质凌厉沉肃的身影从人群中踏步而出，径直走向斗法空地中央，周身萦绕着一股咄咄逼人的蛮横气息。
“霸者州王牧，特向楚道友讨教！”
话音刚落，王牧掌心狂暴雄浑的灵力冲天而起，数件本命法宝齐出，各色绝杀神通席卷而来，攻势铺天盖地，妄图一上来便以雷霆之势压制楚君珩。
楚君珩立在原地半步未动，左手轻抬，清辉流转，一层薄而坚韧的月华屏障在身前缓缓成型。
紧接着，他悄然将势之法则融入屏障之中。
王牧轰出的道道凌厉攻击撞在月光屏障上，力道瞬间被层层瓦解，攻势再难凝聚一体。
content_en:
The moment Shi Cen finished speaking, his arms hanging by his sides were still trembling slightly, and the bloodshot streak at the corner of his mouth was particularly eye-catching on his pale face.
He raised his eyes to look at Chu Junheng's figure opposite him, his lips moved, and in the end he didn't say anything more. He just nodded slightly in that direction, then turned around and returned to his seat.
In the hall of the Ten Star Spirit Brewing Pavilion, after he turned and left for a few breaths, a brief dead silence fell.
But then, the silence was drowned by the uproar that surged like a tide, like a hot wave being stirred up, spreading layer by layer in all directions.
No one expected that this monk from Cangwu Province, who could only fight to a draw with Mo Wuji, a second-tier mid-level player ten years ago, would now have transformed to such a terrifying level.
One person possesses the three high-level original laws of power, destiny, and killing.
Moreover, the control of the three is extremely high, coupled with a complete set of top-level exercises "Ming Yue Ce", the moves are progressive and continuous, and the offensive and defensive containment are impeccable.
He is completely different from the person he was ten years ago. He is completely different.
"How could Chu Junheng be so strong?"
Some people couldn't help but speak, with shock in their tone that had not yet dissipated.
"Yes, obviously I fought with Mo Wuji before, and I could only fight to a draw with exhaustion."
"Ordinary monks spend ten years of hard training, and being able to steadily improve to a small level is already an extraordinary talent. However, this Chu Junheng has directly jumped from the second level of genius to the top level. Such a huge leap, looking at all the states, I am afraid that there are not many."
"But Liu Chengfeng just now should be counted as one, and Jiang Wang."
"I can only say that each of these people in Cangwu Prefecture is better at hiding than the last."
Everyone is now reassessing the true weight of Cangwu Province's heritage.
After all, although Jiang Wang's sudden emergence was shocking enough, in the eyes of many people, it was the limit for a small state to produce a truly top-notch powerhouse.
Unexpectedly, Liu Chengfeng, who is proficient in the laws of space, and Chu Junheng, who is now more powerful than him...
This already means that Cangwu Prefecture does not only rely on Jiang Wang to support the scene, but actually has at least three top monks who are enough to be ranked first in the reception.
"Who was saying before that Cangwu Province was just lucky enough to produce a strong man? I'm afraid no one will say this anymore, right?"
"Cangwu State has thin spiritual energy and scarce resources. They can grow up in such a barren environment. If they were born in super big states with abundant spiritual energy and many opportunities like Hangu and Dayuan, their achievements would probably be even higher."
Seeing that everyone was shocked by Chu Junheng's strength.
Everyone in Cangwu Prefecture knew very well that in the duel just now, Chu Junheng had not even used all his trump cards——
For example, the artistic conception of the king.
However, they can also feel that Chu Junheng's abilities in all aspects have also improved greatly compared to when he asked for help.
Although Liu Chengfeng defeated two strong opponents in succession with his space-origin magical power, he unfortunately lost in the third game.
On the other hand, Chu Junheng has a solid foundation and is more stable than Liu Chengfeng. This will also be reflected in the following games.
I saw a figure with a sharp and solemn temperament wearing a robe trimmed with gold threads stepping out from the crowd and walking straight to the center of the fighting field, with an aggressive and arrogant aura lingering around him.
"Wang Mu of Bazhe State, I would like to ask fellow Daoist Chu for advice!"
As soon as he finished speaking, the violent and powerful spiritual power in Wang Mu's palm soared into the sky, several natal magic weapons came out, and all kinds of killer magical powers swept in. The offensive was overwhelming, hoping to suppress Chu Junheng with the power of thunder.
Chu Junheng stood there without moving for half a step, raising his left hand slightly, the clear light flowed, and a thin but tough moonlight barrier slowly formed in front of him.
Immediately afterwards, he quietly integrated the law of potential into the barrier.
Wang Mu's fierce attacks hit the moonlight barrier, and their strength was instantly disintegrated layer by layer, making it difficult to unite the offensive.
